### Source
GitHub issues in `johnnylarner/exposed`, searched with authenticated `gh`.

### What I searched
- Listed all open and closed issues, limit 100: only #12, #16, and #38.
- Searches: `repo:johnnylarner/exposed is:issue flash`, `navigation`, `white`, `routing`, and `frontend`.
- Inspected #16’s matching text and comments.

### Evidence and gaps
No issues matched `flash`, `navigation`, `white`, or `routing`. No issue documents the white navigation flash or explains the original routing/background choices.

`frontend` matched [#16](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/issues/16), but only because its out-of-scope section says:

> “Rewriting the legacy Python importer or unrelated member, search, and frontend behavior.”

It has no comments and provides no relevant navigation evidence.

The entire issue inventory concerns ingestion or dependency behavior:
- [#12](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/issues/12): Rust member capture/loading.
- [#16](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/issues/16): declaration capture.
- [#38](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/issues/38): weldrs distance discrepancies.

### Contradictions / additional leads
None in the issue category. PRs #10, #24, and #46 remain source-control leads assigned elsewhere.
